widget.draw: function draw(ctx, state, t) { function fmt(v) { return Math.round(v * 100) / 100; } var w = state.w; var h = state.h; var m = state.m; var v = state.v; var s = Math.sqrt(v); var step = m / s; ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h); ctx.fillStyle = "#f6f3ec"; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h); var baseX = 150; var maxLen = 380; var labels = ["m", "sqrt(v)", "step"]; var vals = [m, s, step]; var colors = ["#1f4b99", "#5a7dc4", "#c4512c"]; var i = 0; ctx.font = "13px sans-serif"; ctx.textAlign = "left"; ctx.textBaseline = "middle"; for (i = 0; i < 3; i = i + 1) { var y = 70 + i * 70; var len = vals[i] * maxLen; ctx.fillStyle = "#e4d6c4"; ctx.fillRect(baseX, y, maxLen, 22); ctx.fillStyle = colors[i]; ctx.fillRect(baseX, y, len, 22); ctx.fillStyle = "#1d1a16"; ctx.fillText(labels[i], 30, y + 11); } ctx.font = "14px sans-serif"; ctx.fillStyle = "#1d1a16"; ctx.fillText("m = " + fmt(m), 30, 300); ctx.fillText("v = " + fmt(v), 180, 300); ctx.fillText("step = " + fmt(step), 330, 300); ctx.font = "12px sans-serif"; ctx.fillStyle = "#5c564c"; ctx.fillText("to scale: length proportional to value", 30, 30); ctx.fillText("valley stays bounded", 30, 330); }
